title: broken_wheat_kichdi
howToPrepare:
Ingredients:

        broken wheat

        Tomatoes

        onion

        moong dal 

        coriander powder

        cumin powder

        turmeric powder

        garam masala

        choice of vegetables like carrot, beans, potato, peas etc 
        How to prepare
        1. In a pan add some oil
        2. Then add 1 onion, 1 tomatoes and some salt and fry for 2 minutes
        3. Now, add some red chilli powder, turmeric powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, ginger garlic paste
        4. Fry until tomatoes and onions are cooked well then add vegetables and moong dal and broken wheat 
        5. now mix them well add add water, lemon juice and salt to taste and pressure cook for 3 whistle.
